About.title: About the Creator
About.subtitle: a.k.a. Future Hokage - The Dark Lord of Half-Finished Projects
About.paragraphOne: You have stumbled into the lair of Future - a shadowy figure who lurks in the code mines of Novi Sad, wielding nothing but caffeine, questionable life choices, and a red lightsaber that's mostly for dramatic effect.
About.paragraphTwo: I am Future Hokage aka Master Baiter, a caffeine-fueled Sith cosplayer who's been called "Future" for over a decade but still hasn't managed to drop the "Future" and become a proper Hokage.
About.paragraphThree: Naturally, I start pet projects like a galactic conqueror and abandon them somewhere between "this will change everything" and "why did I think this was a good idea again?"
About.superpower: Turning "just a quick weekend tool" into month-long obsessions with custom auth systems.
About.weakness: Shiny new frameworks, coffee, and clickbait YouTube titles.
About.status: Building this very website. Will it be finished? The prophecy remains unclear.
About.closing: Here you'll find a glorious mess of chaotic experiments, meme-powered code, and questionable life decisions turned into software.
About.signature: - Future Hokage aka Master Baiter (Elusive Joe)
About.tagline: 1-Day NNN Champion - Professional Overthinker - Sith Lord of Procrastination
